exposure: single ultrasound-guided high-intensity focused ultrasound (USgHIFU) ablation
outcome: need for suction curettage for persistent vaginal discharge
cohort: The study included 40 patients diagnosed with placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) disorder who received a single session of HIFU treatment.
finding: Single ultrasound-guided high-intensity focused ultrasound (USgHIFU) ablation is an effective treatment option for managing placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) disorder.
